The '''B-20 Night Hunter blaster''', manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], was a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

A [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] version of the B-20 model was created just before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] millennia after the Cold War.<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>
